newsitem.title: FINLAND: HARTWALL EXTENDS GAINS, HITS LIFE HIGH.
newsitem.headline: HARTWALL EXTENDS GAINS, HITS LIFE HIGH.

text.p: Shares in Finnish beverages group Oy Hartwall Ab extended gains on Friday to hit a new life-high in active trade boosted by strong January-August profits the company released on Thursday, brokers said.

At 1405/1105 GMT, Hartwall traded at 145.00 markka, up 11.00 markka or more than eight percent, after hitting a new life-high at 148.00. Trade was some 12 million markka, which is lively for Hartwall.
Hartwall's eight-month profit after financial items was 139.8 million markka, sharply up from 42.4 million in the first eight months in 1995. -- Helsinki newsroom +358-0-6805 0248
